facts.fact: The Countdown 2030 Angola synthesis report compares health-facility data with results of the DHS 2023 survey, which it uses for coverage estimates.

AGO.note: The report scores national data quality but does not state tiers, where data is digitised, clinic shares or ownership.

facts.fact: The Countdown 2030 report says national routine facility reports run through DHIS2 in Angola, whose 2020-2021 implementation lowered data quality; it gives national completeness of 71% of expected monthly facility reports in 2025, with private sector not reporting and gaps in several provinces.
The report gives national completeness of monthly facility reporting as 71% of expected reports in 2025, 120% in 2024, and 24% of districts at 90% or more in 2025.
